issue.title: agents_tribe_panel_prompts glance/inspect PNG goldens drift: (no Patch) clan row gains a 'sase' project-tag prefix

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Deterministic drift, not a flake: `just test-visual -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_tribe_prompts.py` at master 9f8c4c529e (2026-10-03, sase-1ex.land) reports check drift with updated=2 for agents_tribe_panel_prompts_glance_120x40.png and agents_tribe_panel_prompts_inspect_120x40.png. sase-1ex.6 (note #4, 2026-10-02) saw the same two goldens drift on its clean base tree.

What changed: the `(no Patch)` clan row now renders a leading project tag. The golden has `(RUNNING) ×2 [R2] visual-prompts-clan`; the current capture has `sase (RUNNING) ×2 [R2] visual-prompts-clan`. Nothing else in the bounding box (x 120-630, y 336-359) differs. The goldens were last updated in f379c64179 (sase-1bc.12, 2026-09-28), so a later Agents/clan row change added the prefix without refreshing these goldens.

Fix: decide whether the project-tag prefix on that row is intended. If it is, refresh the two goldens with `just fix-tui-screenshots -- tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_tribe_prompts.py`, after inspecting the report. If it is not, fix the row renderer. Not caused by sase-1ex: the drift predates sase-1ex.6's change and no sase-1ex phase touches clan rows.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1ex.6 and reproduced by sase-1ex.land at master: two Agents tribe goldens drift deterministically, and no bead owns them.
